_comment: Blood Sun step 3 (parent ruling 2026-11-20, the Karoo gap): BLOOD SUN, THEN A KAROO PLAYED UNTAPPED, THEN ITS MANA
SPENT IN THE SAME TURN is found by the autonomous search. Four Mountains; hand Blood Sun, Gruul Turf, Lightning Bolt;
every draw is a Lightning Bolt; the opponent is at 6. The ONLY turn-3 kill: Blood Sun off three Mountains (its ETB
draws a Bolt), then Gruul Turf -- now a plain land: untapped, no bounce -- then Bolt + Bolt off the fourth Mountain
and the Turf's {R}. Without Blood Sun the Turf enters tapped and returns a land (3 mana after the float: one Bolt);
with the Turf played BEFORE Blood Sun the same (Blood Sun + one Bolt). The top-level plan enumerates a Karoo's casts
on the pre-Karoo board, so the Bolts after the Turf come from the Blood Sun draw breakpoint's continuation, which
runs after the deferred Karoo is played (ApplyPlanDirect / AIEngine::TakeTurn: deferred drop, then the re-solve).

Route proof: with MTG_BP_PUT_IN_HAND=0 (the draw's site-10 breakpoint off) this fixture wins on turn 4 instead. Unlimited budget here (completeness); the budgeted twin is bloodsun_sun_then_karoo_budgeted.json.
